own_solution.law: Classical Doppler shift applied to reception and reflection at the moving panel, then reception at the moving recorder: f_rec = 1500(343-6)(343-9)/[343(343+6)]. The requested decrease is 1500-f_rec.
assumptions: The recorder moves with the trolley unless a sentence specifies additional motion.
Conveyor speeds along the trolley are measured relative to the trolley.
The received signal is the steady reflected note after its arrival.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: TA134 and TA6A4 omit the numerical speed and unit, whereas their corresponding speed variants specify 5.3 m/s, violating the stated requirement that variants preserve the number and unit.

counterexamples.case: TA134 permits a toolbox conveyor speed of 2 m/s, whereas T4BE2 explicitly specifies 5.3 m/s.
TA6A4 permits an earlier recorder conveyor speed of 2 m/s, whereas T02E2 explicitly specifies 5.3 m/s.

notes: The base physics and all individual requested frequency decreases are well-posed. Initial panel distance enters propagation timing but cancels from the steady frequency. Toolbox motion and recorder motion confined to an earlier run do not affect the current reflected frequency. Current recorder conveyor motion makes its air-frame speed away from the lorry 14.3 m/s, giving a decrease of 111.96 Hz. The invalid verdict concerns the required matching of variant quantities.
